summary: Verified CI build-failure fix for translation parity. All three node lint scripts exit 0 (check_lang_parity.js, check_panel_lang_parity.js, lint_async_in_if.js). The 5 new an.* keys (byDevice, totalVisitorsSince, totalVisitorsForSince, noVisitorsForDomain, lifetimeReach) are present in all 4 locales (en, fr, hi, zh) with consistent {{date}} and {{domain}} placeholders. Frontend smoke-tested the HostPanel Analytics tab in French with mocked /api/panel/visitors* and /api/panel/analytics* endpoints: lifetime banner shows 'Total des visiteurs de main-site.com depuis le Aug 1, 2026', By Device section shows 'Par appareil' (rendered uppercase via CSS text-transform), no raw an.* keys present in rendered DOM. Login (wpapps01/246810) works. Fix is verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: All lint gates green and translation parity confirmed across en/fr/hi/zh (790 keys each). Placeholders {{date}} and {{domain}} consistent across locales.
